computedeck.description: Watch your GPU cluster, open terminals, and deploy jobs in the editor. Open “How to Use” to get started in three steps.
computedeck.mcp.label: ComputeDeck
computedeck.config.title: ComputeDeck
computedeck.config.apiBase: Control host address. Keep the default http://127.0.0.1:8787 when you are on the control machine.
computedeck.config.pollIntervalSec: How often the sidebar and status bar refresh (seconds).
computedeck.config.statusBar: Show online nodes and free GPUs in the status bar.
computedeck.config.mcpPath: Path to the AI tools helper. Usually leave as-is.
computedeck.config.sshUser: Default SSH user for node terminals. Leave empty to use the node config.
computedeck.walkthrough.title: ComputeDeck in 5 Minutes
computedeck.walkthrough.connect.title: Connect
computedeck.walkthrough.connect.descript:
On the control host this usually signs in automatically.
[Use Local Key](command:computedeck.useLocalCredentials)
[Password Login](command:computedeck.login)
[How to Use](command:computedeck.openAccess)
computedeck.walkthrough.cluster.title: Cluster and Dashboard
computedeck.walkthrough.cluster.descript:
Sidebar finds nodes; workbench shows free GPUs and actions; full dashboard has charts and the assistant.
[Open Workbench](command:computedeck.openWorkbench)
[Open Full Dashboard](command:computedeck.openDashboard)
[How to Use](command:computedeck.openAccess)
computedeck.walkthrough.nodes.title: Node Terminals and Diagnostics
computedeck.walkthrough.nodes.descriptio:
Use inline buttons to open a terminal, run diagnostics, cordon, or free a node.
[Node Actions](command:computedeck.nodeMenu)
computedeck.walkthrough.jobs.title: Deploy and Control Tasks
computedeck.walkthrough.jobs.description:
Deploy by GPU count or pick a node; start / restart / stop inline.
[Deploy Task](command:computedeck.deployJob)
computedeck.walkthrough.mcp.title: Assistant and AI Tools
computedeck.walkthrough.mcp.description:
Configure the assistant API first, then chat on the dashboard; optionally register tools for Copilot.
[Open Assistant](command:computedeck.openAssistant)
[Configure Assistant API](command:computedeck.configureAssistant)
[Register AI Tools](command:computedeck.installMcp)
computedeck.config.autoLocalAuth: Sign in automatically when this workspace is the control-host repo.
computedeck.config.controlRoot: Path to the control-host repo. Leave empty to auto-detect.
computedeck.config.uiOpenMode: How to open the full dashboard. Default auto starts with How to Use.
computedeck.config.uiOpenMode.auto: Web IDE → How to Use first; desktop prefers the in-editor browser.
computedeck.config.uiOpenMode.access: Always open How to Use first.
computedeck.config.uiOpenMode.simpleBrow: Always open the dashboard in the editor browser.
computedeck.config.uiOpenMode.embed: Advanced: try embedding (may fail in some environments).
computedeck.config.uiOpenMode.external: Always open in the system browser.
